pairs.why: B keeps one wood hue family on green, like the real cards, while A adds a loud purple lining as an extra hue family.
A's rope is a richer, more chromatic gold with a deeper shade, closer to the saturated heroes on the real cards. B's rope is paler.
A's hat is a saturated blue-violet that contrasts with the orange ground, like the real navy cap. B's hat is a muted brown-purple with low chroma.
Both ropes use the same yellow-gold on purple with a small red accent, so color gives no reason to choose.
Both use the same blue door, orange frame, cream wall and green ivy palette, matching the real card equally.
A has the real card's red-to-pink background and a peach floor. B shifts the background to orange and warms the whole card.
B's deep saturated navy hero with warm wood and teal matches the real saturated heroes. A has a large neutral white and grey barrel.
Both have the same green grass, lavender-grey stone and navy checks, and both add a blue sky that the real card lacks.
